N=18; cutr=9; cutc=8
out=[[1]*N for _ in range(N)]
# preserve 7 cells on either ray; paint marker ray to farthest 7 on each line
# horizontal from left through max c with 7 on row
h7=[c for c in range(N) if grid[cutr][c]==7]
endc=max(h7)
for c in range(endc+1): out[cutr][c]=7 if grid[cutr][c]==7 else 2
# vertical from top through max row with 7 in col
v7=[r for r in range(N) if grid[r][cutc]==7]
endr=max(v7)
for r in range(endr+1): out[r][cutc]=7 if grid[r][cutc]==7 else 2
# preserve all original line 7s (e.g. lines may cross in non-ray portions? none beyond endpoints)
for r in range(N):
 for c in range(N):
  if grid[r][c]==7 and (r==cutr or c==cutc): out[r][c]=7
# move off-line cells in four quadrants
for top in [True,False]:
 for left in [True,False]:
  cells=[(r,c) for r in range(N) for c in range(N) if grid[r][c]==7 and r!=cutr and c!=cutc and (r<cutr if top else r>cutr) and (c<cutc if left else c>cutc)]
  if not cells: continue
  minr=min(r for r,c in cells); maxr=max(r for r,c in cells); minc=min(c for r,c in cells); maxc=max(c for r,c in cells)
  dr=(-minr if top else N-1-maxr); dc=(-minc if left else N-1-maxc)
  for r,c in cells: out[r+dr][c+dc]=7
print('h7',h7,endc,'v7',v7,endr)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
